title: My Creative Identity
hoursNote: The fourteen sessions support the award; they do not supply its whole 60-hour programme. Record actual guided and independent time.

parts.A: Explore the arts as a participant
parts.B: Explore the arts as an audience member

cellsNote: AAE-H7: no invented workbook claim; award plan binding is measured by g29.

outcomes: Record a baseline: one piece made today, and three words for what it does well and one for what it does not.
lessons.objective: Record a baseline today by making one piece, then writing three words for what it does well and one word for what it does not do yet.

outcomes: Choose one art-form skill to develop, and write the measure that will show it changed.
lessons.objective: Choose one art-form skill to develop, and write the measure that will show it changed.

outcomes: Work on the chosen skill and record what changed between the first attempt and the last.
lessons.objective: Work on the skill you chose, keep the tool and the box the same, and record what changed between your first attempt and your last.

outcomes: Work on the skill again, take one piece of feedback from a named person, and write it down in their words.
lessons.objective: Work on your chosen skill again, take one piece of feedback from a named person, and write that feedback down in their own words.

outcomes: Apply the feedback once, on the piece, and record what it did.
lessons.objective: Apply the one piece of feedback you took, once, on one named part of your piece, and record what the change did.

outcomes: Summarise what was learnt across Part A against the measure set in week one.
lessons.objective: Summarise what you learnt across Part A in your own words, checked against the measure you set in week one.

outcomes: Name what an audience member notices, and why noticing is the evidence.
lessons.objective: Name what an audience member notices, and say why noticing is the evidence a review is built on.

outcomes: Prepare the review frame: the moment, the craft choice, the effect, and who it was for.
lessons.objective: Prepare your review frame before the experience, so every row holds the moment, the craft choice, the effect, and who it was for.

outcomes: Experience the arts event or exhibition through EVENT_SLOT, review its quality and creative impact, then share that review with another person and record whom, how and the evidence locator.
lessons.objective: Experience the arts, review a craft choice and its effect, then share your view and record whom, how and where the evidence is saved.

outcomes: Choose a real artist, craftsperson or practitioner from the approved pack and say why they were chosen.
lessons.objective: Choose a real arts practitioner from checked sources and explain the choice through a feature of their work.

outcomes: Research the chosen real practitioner’s practice, career, life and work, and record where each fact came from.
lessons.objective: Research the chosen real practitioner’s practice, career, life and work, using sources that support each fact.

outcomes: Choose an arts skill and plan a short workshop or presentation for a peer, small group or staff member.
lessons.objective: Choose an art skill to pass on and test your own plan for a short share.

outcomes: Deliver the planned arts workshop or presentation and capture what the learner did and the feedback received.
lessons.objective: Use your plan to pass on an art skill, check the learner's response and keep evidence of your role.

outcomes: Review how well the skills share went against the plan, and locate the genuine evidence for all four Bronze parts.
lessons.objective: Review how well your skills share went, then find the evidence for all four Bronze parts.
